name: The Key to Freedom
summary: In Searing Gorge, you have a small brass key with no known destination. Its head reads Dark Iron Outhouse and warns against copying it.

sections.title: A Marked Key
sections.body: The small brass key is marked Dark Iron Outhouse, with a warning not to duplicate it. Where it leads remains unknown. Search Searing Gorge for a place that accepts it.

sections.title: An Interrupted Visit
sections.body: A cough comes from inside the wooden outhouse. Someone asks who is there, annoyed at the interruption. Locheed is delighted you found the key. The Dark Irons hid it after locking him inside.

faq.q: What is written on the Grimesilt Outhouse Key?
faq.answer: The key's head reads Dark Iron Outhouse and warns against copying it.
You cannot yet tell where the key leads. It is marked for a Dark Iron outhouse, somewhere in Searing Gorge.
